preconditions.description: The input string s has length between 1 and 10 (inclusive), and consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NA' or (len(stdout.strip()) == len(stdin.strip()) + 1 and all(stdout.strip()[i] == stdout.strip()[-1 - i] for i in range(len(stdout.strip()) // 2)))
postconditions.description: If a valid palindrome can be formed by inserting exactly one lowercase English letter into s, stdout is that palindrome; otherwise, stdout is 'NA'. The output string must be a palindrome and exactly one character longer than the input.

postconditions.expression: any(all(stdout.strip()[i] == stdin.strip()[i] for i in range(min(len(stdin.strip()), len(stdout.strip())))) for c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for pos in range(len(stdin.strip()) + 1) if (s := stdin.strip()[:pos] + c + stdin.strip()[pos:]) and all(s[i] == s[-1 - i] for i in range(len(s) // 2)))
postconditions.description: The output string is formed by inserting exactly one lowercase English letter into s at any position (including start or end), and the resulting string is a palindrome. If no such insertion exists, stdout is 'NA'.
